title: Legacy Monolith Refactoring with Cursor
business: Enterprise teams maintaining large, undocumented legacy codebases.
problem: Engineers struggle to understand cross-module dependencies, leading to high regression risks when attempting to refactor or modernize specific features.
solution: Cursor provides codebase-aware agents that map repository structures to identify relevant files and suggest safe refactoring paths based on existing logic patterns.
steps: Index the local repository to allow the agent to understand the codebase structure.
Use the agent to trace dependencies between the legacy module and the rest of the application.
Define a scope for the refactor using Plan Mode to outline necessary changes.
Execute iterative updates using the agent to apply and verify code transformations.
Review generated diffs to ensure logic consistency before merging.
outcome: Improved developer velocity and reduced regression incidents during complex refactoring tasks.
limitation: The agent may occasionally hallucinate architectural patterns if the codebase lacks consistent coding standards; verify all suggestions against existing unit tests.
